{{Quest|Reforger}} |location = [[Blacksmith (Zone)]] |location_page_description = Allows the player to [[Reforge]] items, after providing {{Item|Coal|amount=10}}. |x = 10.5 |y = 63 |z = -126.5 |location2 = [[Gold Mine]] |location_page_description2 = Allows the player to [[Reforge]] items. |x2 = -39.5 |y2 = 77 |z2 = -299.5 |location3 = [[Dwarven Village]] |location_page_description3 = Allows the player to [[Reforge]] items. |x3 = -6.5 |y3 = 201 |z3 = -154.5 }} The '''Blacksmith''' is an [[NPC]] located in {{Zone|Blacksmith}}, {{Zone|Gold Mine}}, and {{Zone|Dwarven Village}}. They are a service character that will [[Reforge]] your gear for a fee, depending on the [[rarity]] of your gear. == Reforging == {{Main|Reforging}} There is an [[Anvil]] next to the blacksmith, allowing the player to [[Enchantments|Enchant]] their gear using books at the cost of experience levels. == Quest == When first interacting with the '''Blacksmith''', he introduces you to the service he provides and then gives the player a [[Quest]], titled "Time To Mine". This requires the player to mine {{Item|Coal|amount=10}} and reach {{Skill|mining|1}}. After doing so, the [[player]] will unlock the '''Blacksmith''''s menu. == Interface == {{/UI}} == Dialogue == {| class="wikitable" !colspan="2" |Condition !Dialogue |- |colspan="2" class="ct" | First Interaction |{{Dialogue| &e[NPC] &6Blacksmith&f: &fI'm the town Blacksmith!
